resumen: One step forward, down until both knees are at about 90 degrees, and back. Each leg works on its own, and balance becomes part of the exercise.
ejecucion: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms relaxed at your sides.
Step forward and lower straight down, bending both knees to about 90 degrees.
The front knee stays over the foot; the back knee comes close to the floor without touching it.
Push through the front foot to return to the start, then switch legs.
matices: The balance between quadriceps and glutes depends on step length and how much the torso leans, two things everyone does differently. In the cited study, with a standard step, the quadriceps vasti lead.
